title: Saudi-Backed Forces in Yemen Retreat From Red Sea as Houthis Advance
summary_full: The move is a setback for the Yemeni government and its ally Saudi Arabia, as analysts said the balance of power in the country’s civil war was tilting toward the Iran-backed Houthi militia.
